parent.description: Config type instance that contains this config child.

locales.description:
A list of locales that are available to users of the web application.

- These locales should be present in the application's {@link Locale} seed data.
- If the user's preferences do not match any of the available locales, the
  application will use the first locale in this list.
- If this list is empty, the application will fallback to `'en'`.

title: Specifies the internationalization settings for UI applications.
name: UiSdlI18nConfig
